intro: This policy explains what personal information Celestial Dental Centre collects through celestialdental.org, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices and rights you have. We handle personal data in line with Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Celestial Dental Centre runs dental clinics in Kasarani (Nairobi), Kamakis (Ruiru), Eldoret and Kiambu Road (Thindigua), and operates this website. We decide how the personal data collected through this website is used, which makes us its data controller.
Contact us about anything in this policy at info@celestialdental.org or on +254 709 000 240.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy covers information collected through this website. The clinical records created when you are seen at a branch (your examination findings, X-rays and treatment notes) are kept by that branch as part of your care; ask the branch if you have a question about them.

sections.heading: Information we collect
bullets: Appointment requests: your name, phone number, email address (optional), the branch, service, date and time you choose, any message you add, and how you heard about us. We also record the type of browser you used and the approximate town and country your connection came from, so that we can spot fake or automated bookings. We do not store your IP address.
Job applications: your name, email address, phone number, the role you are applying for, notice period, salary expectation, cover letter and CV.
Blog comments: the name and comment you enter. Comments are published on the article for other visitors to read.

Website visits: the page you opened, the website that sent you, the approximate town and country, whether you are on a phone or a computer, and any campaign tags in the link you followed (for example utm_source).
Messages you send us by phone, WhatsApp or email.

sections.heading: How we use it
bullets: To arrange, confirm and follow up on your appointment. A new booking is sent to the chosen branch, including by WhatsApp, so that the team can contact you.
To consider your job application and reply to you.
To publish and moderate blog comments.
To understand which pages and campaigns bring visitors, and to keep the website working and secure.
With your permission only: to measure our advertising and to show you our adverts on other websites (see Cookies below).
paragraphs: We use your information on the basis of your consent, to take the steps you ask for (such as booking an appointment), and for our legitimate interest in running and protecting the website. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar storage
paragraphs: When you first visit, we ask whether you allow marketing cookies. If you decline, no advertising or analytics tags are loaded and no visitor cookie is set.

If you allow them, we set a cookie (cd_vid) that recognises a returning browser for up to one year, and we load Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and, where enabled, the Google Ads and Meta advertising tags. These services set their own cookies under their own privacy policies.

Your browser also keeps your cookie choice and, for up to 90 days, the campaign link that first brought you to the site, so that a later booking can be credited to it. This stays on your device. Clearing your browser's site data removes it and lets you choose again.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share personal data only with the service providers we need to run the website, each acting on our instructions: our web host (HOSTAFRICA), our application host and file storage (Vercel), our database provider (Neon), our email delivery provider, WhatsApp (to notify the branch of a booking), our patient-relationship system, and an IP location service that turns a connection into an approximate town and country. With your consent, Google and Meta receive the data described under Cookies.
Some of these providers store data outside Kenya. Where they do, we rely on the safeguards they provide for international transfers.
We may also disclose information where the law requires it.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep appointment requests and job applications for as long as we need them for the purpose they were given and for our records, and then delete them. Blog comments stay published until they are removed. Website visit records are kept in summary form for reporting. You can ask us to delete your information sooner (see below).

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the Data Protection Act, 2019 you have the right to be told how your data is used, to see the personal data we hold about you, to have wrong or misleading data corrected, to have data deleted, to object to its use, and to withdraw consent at any time. To use any of these rights, email info@celestialdental.org from the address or phone number you gave us, so that we can confirm it is you.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (www.odpc.go.ke).

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Appointments for children should be booked by a parent or guardian, who provides the child's details on the child's behalf.

sections.heading: Keeping data safe
paragraphs: Our admin area is protected by individual staff accounts, and the website and its connections are encrypted (HTTPS). No system is completely secure, so please do not send detailed medical information through the booking form; you can discuss it with the dentist at your visit.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will update this page when our practices change, and change the date at the top.
